theorem continueRun_prefix (cfg : Config P A D) (boundaries : ParallelBoundary P A D)
    (policy : Policy P A D) (left right : Branch P A D) (m : Machine P A D)
    (schedule : Schedule) :
    ∃ preTokens suffix, schedule = preTokens ++ suffix ∧
